items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-27
items.q: Dutch was, he fixed, he fixed Eddie Miller's Ford before Eddie Miller went to New York.

ctx.x: Yeah, we did, but we didn't get the rest of the band, so it kept going.
